title: The four edges of the completed reduction square
statement:
Use the adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with Noetherian $A$, ideal $I$, and finite perfect quotients $P_n=A/I^n$. Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be the cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$ proper, and let $K\in D(X_{\Proet},A)$ be derived $I$-complete. Equip each $K_n=K\otimes_A^LP_n$ with the specified etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness] required by [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map]. Use the corners $A_n,B_n,C_n,D_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-four-corners] and the arrows $h_n,h'_n,v'_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-four-arrows]. All tensor products below use the coefficient sheaves of this datum, and $n\geq1$.

Put

$$
S=Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K,
\qquad T=Rf'_*L(g')^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K.
$$

Let

$$
\sigma_n:S\otimes^LP_n\xrightarrow{\sim}A_n
$$

be the functorial finite reduction of completed pullback of [lemma-weil-pbc-completed-pullback-reduction], applied to $Rf_*K$; this input is derived complete by [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. For $E=L(g')^*K$, let

$$
\tau_n:T\otimes^LP_n\xrightarrow{\sim}C_n
$$

be the inverse of
$\chi:\widehat{Rf'_*E}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*\widehat E=T$, tensored with
$P_n$, followed by finite reduction of $\widehat{Rf'_*E}$.
Here $\widehat M:=\Rlim_m(M\otimes_A^LP_m)$ is the quotient-tower model, identified with the intrinsic Koszul completion of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] by [prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction]. More explicitly, write $M=Rf'_*E$ and let
$$
\rho_{M,n}:\widehat M\otimes_A^LP_n\xrightarrow{\sim}M\otimes_A^LP_n=C_n
$$
be projection to level $n$ from [lem-weil-pbc-finite-reduction-reconstruction] on the strict reduction tower of $M$. Choose $\chi$ to be the ordered composite
$$
\widehat{Rf'_*E}\xrightarrow{\Rlim_m(\pi_{f',E,P_m})}\Rlim_m Rf'_*(E\otimes_A^LP_m)
\xrightarrow{\lambda_E^{-1}}Rf'_*\widehat E=T.
$$
The maps $\pi_{f',E,P_m}$ are the projection-formula maps [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map], isomorphisms by [lemma-weil-pbc-perfect-projection-formula], and $\lambda_E:Rf'_*\Rlim_m(E\otimes_A^LP_m)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Rlim_m Rf'_*(E\otimes_A^LP_m)$ is the canonical direct-image/derived-limit comparison of [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. For the quotient transition $q_m:P_{m+1}\to P_m$, use the compatible family of projection-formula maps specified by
$$
 Rf'_*(1_E\otimes^L q_m)\circ\pi_{f',E,P_{m+1}} =\pi_{f',E,P_m}\circ(1_M\otimes^L q_m).
$$
The limits and this tower morphism are taken after restriction to the ambient $A$-coefficient category; the displayed reduced edges are morphisms in $D(Y'_{\Proet},P_n)$.
The identification $\widehat E= L(g')^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$ is the completed-pullback construction [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Thus the specified order is
$$
\tau_n=\rho_{M,n}\circ(\chi^{-1}\otimes^L1_{P_n}).
$$
Define

$$
\alpha_n=h_n\sigma_n:S\otimes^LP_n\to B_n,
\qquad
\delta_n=h'_n\tau_n:T\otimes^LP_n\to D_n,
$$

and let

$$
\overline\xi_n=
\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp}}_{\square,K}\otimes^L1_{P_n}:
S\otimes^LP_n\longrightarrow T\otimes^LP_n.
$$

The lower edge is the specified $v'_n:B_n\xrightarrow{\sim}D_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-four-arrows]; the upper edge is $\overline\xi_n$, and the left and right edges are $\alpha_n$ and $\delta_n$. This definition makes no assertion of commutativity.

Thus every arrow in the completed reduction square is named, typed, and
expressed as an ordered composite of reduction, direct-image, projection-
formula, or base-change maps.

split_report.summary: Made the inherited coefficient and square context explicit, restored the missing corner and arrow dependencies, and specified the completion/direct-image comparison and the order of its inverse in tau_n using existing nodes. No new nodes; definition only, with no assertion that the reduction square commutes. Second reading explicitly cites Koszul/quotient reconstruction and the projection-formula map, and names the lower edge. Repair after mechanical landing refusal: made the quotient-transition equality and its counit argument explicit in the definition, and specified the ambient category used before reduction.

The comparison chi is expanded into its projection-formula and derived-limit factors.
